meta.title: Workspace Prompt
meta.description: Per-workspace prompt saved from a slash command or Settings, armed by a composer switch, and confirmed once per session before it is injected into the model context.

en.chip.failed.hint: Switch failed: the Host refused the write. If you just upgraded the plugin, restart dsh web and retry.
en.chip.off.hint: Off: sessions are not given this prompt. Click to turn on.
en.chip.on.hint: On: the first injection in a session asks once; after a “skip” that session is never asked again. Click to turn off.
en.chip.readonly.hint: The configuration is read-only right now.
en.chip.skew.hint: The Host half is still the pre-upgrade version: restart dsh web for this switch to take effect.
en.command.description: Configure a workspace-specific prompt for the current workspace
en.error.rejected: the configuration is read-only, or the Host refused the write
en.modal.placeholder: Write a workspace-specific prompt; once the Workspace prompt switch is on, it is injected into the model context at session start…
en.modal.title: Configure workspace prompt
en.settings.add.empty: Every workspace already has a prompt
en.settings.editorHint: While the switch is on, each session is asked once before the prompt goes in.
en.settings.emptyInline: No workspace prompt configured yet: start with “Add workspace” in the top-right corner.
en.settings.intro: Save a dedicated prompt for each workspace. With the switch on, each session is asked once before the prompt is used: include it, or skip it for that session without changing the switch.
en.settings.placeholder: Write a prompt for this workspace…
en.settings.readonly: The configuration is read-only: the Host has not provided a usable form yet. Retry shortly, or restart dsh web after upgrading the plugin.
en.settings.skew: The Host half is still the pre-upgrade version, so the switch is unavailable; restart dsh web to enable it.
en.settings.title: Workspace prompts
en.settings.toggleError: Switch failed: the Host refused the write
